title: HtmlArticle
responsibility: Renders the native article element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlArticle.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native article element; native HTML content rules still apply. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (no child snippet).

outputs.name: HtmlArticle
outputs.description: The actual native article element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper. States: long: The native article element retains long caller content in its normal semantic context.

errors.name: Caller content or event error
errors.description: Supplied event handlers and rendered child snippets may throw; the atom does not catch their errors. Void elements ignore the child snippet.
